allowed_framing: ADES integrates established dynamic shortest-path and caching ideas into an exact bounded adaptive-source-residency architecture.
The focused audit did not find one preexisting system matching the full combination.
The primary supported contribution is systems integration, exactness/fairness methodology, operating-regime analysis, and measured runtime-memory performance.
prohibited_framing: ADES is the first to ignore non-tree edge increases.
ADES is the first cost-aware adaptive cache.
ADES invents choosing incremental repair versus full recomputation using measured cost.
ADES is the first bounded hot-source shortest-path cache.
No prior art exists for ADES.
